title: Federal immigration agent shoots and injures man in Austin, Texas
content: The person shot is in serious but stable condition, Austin Mayor Kirk Watson said in a press conference.

title: Poison suspected in deaths of ten lions in game reserve in Tanzania
content: The lions were found dead inside the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a popular wildlife reserve in Tanzania. Deaths raise concerns over wildlife poisonings in East Africa.

title: Germany's Merz vows to press ahead with reforms after historic state election defeat
content: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has faced a major electoral setback in two state elections, with his center-right party losing ground. The far-right Alternative for Germany party made significant gains.

title: Trump says his D.C. arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and drones
content: President Trump has claimed that military operations are needed at his proposed triumphal arch in Washington D.C., in order to protect national security. A federal court is weighing the arch's legality.

title: PHOTOS: The precarious life of fisherfolk
content: In the bustling heart of the southern Indian city of Chennai is a market that never sleeps, where residents from the poorest neighborhoods wage a battle of survival with the sea.

title: In New Orleans, an empty building becomes a free store — and roller skating rink
content: In the Lower Ninth Ward, an old Family Dollar stands covered in graffiti. It looks abandoned. But inside, it's a treasure trove — clothing, home goods, toys and books. And everything is free.

title: Judge orders Fox to hand over hundreds of documents in shareholders' case
content: Fox Corp. must turn over hundreds of documents that could shed light on how founder Rupert Murdoch handled some of his media companies' biggest scandals.

title: U.S. childcare costs are astronomical. More families are turning to grandparents
content: Grandparents taking care of their grandkids is nothing new. But the surging cost of childcare in the U.S. has made familial support even more critical for some parents who struggle to afford it.

title: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds launched at Moscow
content: Moscow's mayor described the wave of drones as the "largest ever" attack on the Russian capital and said there had been damage to a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building.

title: NPR's College Podcast Challenge is back for 2026
content: Students: It's time to turn on the mic and hit 'record.' Send us your podcasts and we'll pick the best ones. It's $5,000 for our grand prize and $500 for our finalists.
